name: Black Album
source:
One year after the music festival, Yuki Morikawa is nominated for the music festival again. Main character is in good standing with her, so one week before the festival he starts to help preparing. How will festival fare and who will be alongside the protagonist by the end of it?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
音乐节一年后，森川由纪再次获得音乐节提名。主角与她的关系很好，所以在节日前一周他就开始帮忙准备。节日将如何进行？在节日结束时谁将与主角并肩作战？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
